title: #sondheim
transcript: You can't do this. I've heard what you said, JoJo. I've come to tell you I'll keep my distance, stay out of your path. But I can be nearby. I can be there quietly waiting. And this you think will make me love you? No. No. I am doing this because I love you. Well, my heart feels nothing for you. How many times must you hear this? This has nothing to do with your heart. What does to do with your dick? I take a dick.
